_meta.note: Single source of truth for payment amounts and Stripe links, keyed by event type. Each event in trainings.json references one of these via its 'type' field; the build joins them and feeds the payment modal. An event may override any field by setting deposit / price / depositUrl / fullUrl directly on its own record (for special-circumstance events). Buttons stay hidden until a real https link is present here, so this file is safe to deploy with the URLs blank. Paste the Stripe Payment Link URLs into depositUrl / fullUrl when the coordinator provides them.
